entries.text: Added `cse_to_functions`, a `postprocess` function for `cse` that represents the replacement symbols as undefined functions of the differentiation variables they depend on, so that `doit` can be applied to the result without `Derivative` objects collapsing to zero.
`cse` no longer extracts symbol-like objects (those with `is_symbol` true, such as `Indexed` elements and `ArraySymbol` elements) as common subexpressions.
